subject.title: [Feature]: Add a visible browser panel to the Control UI for login handoff and browser management

question: What Control UI browser handoff model should OpenClaw support before implementation?
rationale: The feature crosses UX, authorization, redaction, browser-state exposure, and same-session resume policy, so automation cannot safely choose the product boundary.

options.title: First-party browser handoff panel
options.body: Add a core or bundled-plugin panel with read-only status/tabs/screenshot/manual-login completion first, then gate any write actions behind explicit scopes.

options.title: Plugin-owned tab after UI entry points
options.body: Wait for the generic plugin UI entry-point security model to land, then implement the browser panel as a browser-plugin tab using that surface.

options.title: Keep CLI and docs only
options.body: Document the current CLI and agent-driven login flow as the supported path and defer in-product browser handoff.

recommendation.title: First-party browser handoff panel
recommendation.body: Add a core or bundled-plugin panel with read-only status/tabs/screenshot/manual-login completion first, then gate any write actions behind explicit scopes.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the strongest combined signal across recent browser docs/runtime, Control UI routing history, and the issue discussion.
